companies.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
companies.business: Operates across O2C, Retail, and Digital Services, transitioning to New Energy
thesis: Jio's tariff hikes and 5G monetization will drive a 15%+ EBITDA CAGR over FY25-FY28.
Retail business margin expansion driven by omni-channel scale, premiumization, and own brands crossing critical revenue milestones.
New Energy capex of $10Bn will create a massive new earnings engine by FY28, offsetting structural O2C weakness.

theses.mechanism: Tariff hikes and transition to 5G FWA reducing churn and increasing ARPU
theses.evidence: ARPU grew 13.5% YoY to Rs 206 in FY25

moat.evidence: Jio captured 90% of industry net adds, 5x higher than nearest competitor
moat.testSurvived: Survived the 2020 crude crash and intense telecom price wars
moat.durability: High due to sunk cost of spectrum and infrastructure

people.name: Mukesh Ambani
people.background: Chemical Engineer, visionary architect of Jio and Retail

guidanceRecord.delivered: Achieved ahead of schedule via stake sales

capitalAllocation.summary: Aggressive capex into future growth engines funded by immense internal cash generation

mispricing.concern: O2C margins are permanently impaired by Chinese overcapacity
mispricing.answer: While near-term weakness exists, RIL's complex refining and feedstock flexibility protect it better than peers, and consumer businesses now drive 60%+ of EBITDA.

esg.environment: Targeting net-zero carbon by 2035 via massive renewable investments
esg.social: Significant employment generator, CSR via Reliance Foundation
esg.governance: Stable board, strong execution track record

timeline.event: Tariff hikes in telecom driving ARPU to Rs 206
